name: LockBit: LSASS dump via comsvcs.dll MiniDump
description: rundll32.exe abusing comsvcs.dll MiniDump to dump LSASS memory (T1003.001) — documented LockBit credential-dumping LOLBin.
query: process where process.name : "rundll32.exe" and process.command_line : "*comsvcs*" and process.command_line : "*MiniDump*"
false_positives: Rare legitimate crash-dump collection by support staff

name: LockBit: Security service stop/disable via sc.exe or Set-MpPreference
description: sc.exe stop/config against WinDefend/WdNisSvc/Sense/EventLog or PowerShell Set-MpPreference disabling real-time protection (T1562.001).
query: process where (process.name : "sc.exe" and process.command_line : "*stop*" or process.command_line : "*config*") and (process.command_line : "*WinDefend*" or process.command_line : "*WdNisSvc*" or process.command_line : "*Sense*" or process.command_line : "*EventLog*") or (process.name : ("powershell.exe", "pwsh.exe") and process.command_line : "*Set-MpPreference*" and process.command_line : "*DisableRealtimeMonitoring*")
false_positives: AV management tooling; SOC maintenance windows

name: LockBit: Recovery inhibition or event-log clearing
description: vssadmin delete shadows, bcdedit recoveryenabled no, wbadmin delete catalog, or wevtutil log clearing (T1490/T1070.001) — LockBit impact-stage primitives.
query: process where (process.name : "vssadmin.exe" and process.command_line : "*delete*shadows*") or (process.name : "bcdedit.exe" and process.command_line : "*recoveryenabled*no*") or (process.name : "wbadmin.exe" and process.command_line : "*delete*catalog*") or (process.name : "wevtutil.exe" and process.command_line : "* cl *")

name: LockBit: SAM/SECURITY hive export via reg.exe
description: reg.exe save of SAM, SECURITY, or SYSTEM hives (T1003.002) — local credential harvesting.
query: process where process.name : "reg.exe" and process.command_line : "*save*" and (process.command_line : "*HKLM\\SAM*" or process.command_line : "*HKLM\\SECURITY*" or process.command_line : "*HKLM\\SYSTEM*")
false_positives: Registry backup scripts — baseline approved hosts

name: LockBit: .lockbit encryption burst or ransom note drop
description: Mass file creation with .lockbit extension or Restore-My-Files.txt ransom note (T1486) — LockBit 3.0 impact-stage artifacts.
false_positives: None expected — extension and note name are actor-specific
